summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a UK-style PDMR dealing notification, the US analogue of a Section 16 insider transaction report. The disclosure covers ordinary 25p share purchases on 7 October 2026 under the HMRC-approved Partnership Share Scheme of the Share Incentive Plan: CEO Tadeu Marroco, CMO Luciano Comin and Research and Science Director James Murphy each bought 4 shares at 40.20 pence, £160.80 per person, on the London Stock Exchange. No board recommendation, advisor, stake, premium, or deal mechanics are involved; this is routine compliance disclosure with no risk-arb angle.
